comparison.objective: Fit missing terminal covers and store three battery packs upright in a tray while maintaining protection.
comparison.physical_skill: Cover fitting, protected transport, and upright tray placement.
comparison.success_condition: Each correctly stored pack earns one third; any unprotected tray entry permanently zeros the trial.
comparison.reason: Tests safety interlock sequencing and covered storage. It does not test contact-loaded fracture, hammer control, insert retention, or recovery of generated fragments. No spec versions were provided.
